expected_ground_truth_rule: Maximum 5 days of unused annual leave can be carried over into the following calendar year; any excess days expire on December 31st.
resolution_reasoning: Formal Policy documents (POL-HR-03 v1.2) legally supersede informal departmental FAQ documents (FAQ-HR-01 v1.0). Hierarchy rule: Policy > SOP > FAQ.

rule_topic: Remote Work Core Hours and Equipment Stipend
expected_ground_truth_rule: Core remote collaboration hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM PKT, and new hires are eligible for a one-time $300 home-office equipment stipend.
resolution_reasoning: POL-HR-02 v2.0 explicitly replaces v1.0 (which specified 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM PKT and a $200 stipend). Versioning rule: Higher version number supersedes older versions.

expected_ground_truth_rule: Mandatory hardware-based MFA (FIDO2 / YubiKey) and 14-character minimum passphrase required; SMS OTP authentication is strictly prohibited.
resolution_reasoning: POL-SEC-01 v2.1 supersedes v1.0 (which permitted 10-character passwords and SMS OTP). Versioning rule: Stricter newer security baseline v2.1 takes precedence.

expected_ground_truth_rule: Unacknowledged Severity 1 customer support tickets must be escalated to the On-Call Incident Commander within 15 minutes.
resolution_reasoning: SOP-SUP-01 v2.0 overrides v1.0 (which had a 30-minute escalation threshold) to meet enterprise SLA commitments. Versioning rule: v2.0 supersedes v1.0.

rule_topic: Security Incident and Data Breach Notification SLA
expected_ground_truth_rule: All confirmed security breaches and PII exfiltrations must be reported to the CISO and Data Protection Officer within 24 hours.
resolution_reasoning: POL-SEC-03 v1.1 reduced the permissible breach notification window from 72 hours (in v1.0) to 24 hours due to statutory compliance mandates.

expected_ground_truth_rule: Every production-bound pull request requires at least 2 independent peer approvals and passing SAST/DAST security scanner gates.
resolution_reasoning: SOP-DEV-01 v2.0 enforces 2 peer reviews to satisfy SOC 2 Type II segregation of duties, superseding v1.0's single-reviewer standard.

rule_topic: Cryptographic Key and Secret Rotation Cadence
expected_ground_truth_rule: Database credentials, API tokens, and TLS certificates must be automatically rotated every 90 days via HashiCorp Vault.
resolution_reasoning: Standard Operating Procedure (POL-SEC-05 v2.0) takes precedence over outdated portal FAQ documentation (FAQ-SEC-01 v1.0) which suggested annual manual rotations.

rule_topic: Customer Dispute Refund Approval Limit for Support Tier 2
expected_ground_truth_rule: Level 2 Customer Support Representatives are authorized to approve customer billing refunds up to a maximum cap of $500 per incident.
resolution_reasoning: Domain-specific customer support SOP (SOP-SUP-02 v1.1) governs customer refund authority, overriding general corporate expenditure guidelines in SOP-FIN-01 v1.0.

rule_topic: Physical Clean Desk vs Digital Endpoint Locking
expected_ground_truth_rule: POL-SEC-04 Clean Desk Policy is marked OBSOLETE; digital workstation auto-lock after 5 minutes of inactivity (per POL-SEC-01 v2.1) governs compliance.
resolution_reasoning: POL-SEC-04 v1.0 was formally retired and archived. Modern hybrid/remote endpoint security controls in POL-SEC-01 v2.1 prevail.

rule_topic: Daily Travel Meal Per Diem and Expense Thresholds
expected_ground_truth_rule: Daily business travel meal allowance is capped at $75 per diem, and any expense item exceeding $1,000 requires explicit Department Manager pre-approval.
resolution_reasoning: Operational Finance SOP (SOP-FIN-01 v1.0) specifies exact binding reimbursement caps and workflows, superseding high-level general conduct statements in POL-HR-01 v1.0.
